title: Design GitHub Release CLI artifact format
description: Decide the first GitHub Release artifact format for the Eshyra CLI. The initial public CLI distribution channel is GitHub Releases, not npm. Evaluate whether the first artifact should be a Node-required packaged CLI, a standalone executable, platform-specific archives, or a phased combination. Consider Windows, macOS, Linux, WSL, archive layout, install instructions, license/commercial notice inclusion, third-party content notice inclusion, and how the artifact avoids implying that @eshyra/core is a public SDK.
design:
DECISION — Initial GitHub Release CLI artifact format

Format: per-platform self-contained archive that BUNDLES a pinned Node 24
runtime. The user installs nothing else; no pre-installed Node is required.
Fronted by a one-line installer (curl|sh on Unix, irm|iex on Windows) that
downloads the correct archive, unpacks to a managed dir (e.g. ~/.eshyra/app),
and links a launcher onto PATH. This mirrors the existing trusted dolt-provision
pattern (pinned asset + sha256 verify) and stays consistent with ADR 0008:
the bundled Node is the exact runtime the better-sqlite3 prebuild targets.

NODE REQUIREMENT: Node 24 is REQUIRED to run, but is BUNDLED inside the artifact.
The user is NOT required to install Node. The launcher invokes the bundled Node;
the Claude Agent SDK subprocess (which spawns executable:'node') and the
better-sqlite3 native addon are both pointed at the bundled Node so no system
Node is ever used.

PLATFORM TARGETS (intersection of official Node 24 builds, better-sqlite3 12.x
Node-24 prebuilds, and the existing pinned-dolt manifest):
  - darwin-x64
  - darwin-arm64
  - linux-x64   (WSL maps here)
  - linux-arm64
  - win32-x64
Unix archives ship as .tar.gz; Windows as .zip.

REQUIRED INCLUDED FILES (per archive):
  - bin/eshyra (+ eshyra.cmd / .ps1 launcher on Windows) — launcher to bundled Node
  - runtime/  — pinned Node 24 runtime (node / node.exe)
  - app/      — built @eshyra/cli + @eshyra/core dist (flattened/bundled)
  - app/...better_sqlite3.node — the ABI-matched (Node 24) native prebuild, shipped as a sidecar
  - data/rules-packs/...        — bundled D&D SRD 5.1 content (~7 MB)
  - LICENSE                     — PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0
  - COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md       — commercial-rights reservation notice
  - NOTICE / THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES — (a) SRD 5.1 content attribution/licensing for
        the bundled rules-pack, and (b) bundled-runtime notices for Node,
        better-sqlite3, and the Claude Agent SDK
  - README / INSTALL.txt        — download, install, and first-run instructions

DOLT: NOT bundled and NOT required at install. It is off the per-turn path
(checkpoints/history only) and already self-provisions on first checkpoint use
(pinned dolt v2.0.3, sha256-verified, into ~/.eshyra/dolt). Keep it lazy.

OUT OF SCOPE (explicitly):
  - No npm package publication. Root/workspace package private:true guards stay.
  - No public @eshyra/core SDK packaging or API promise; the archive ships only
    the bundled runtime app, not an installable/importable package surface.
  - A true single-file executable (Node SEA / Bun compile) is deferred to a
    possible later phase; it is blocked today by the un-embeddable native addon
    and the Agent SDK's node-subprocess requirement, and is not Phase 1.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen initial artifact format is recorded. Platform targets are identified. Required included files are listed, including LICENSE, COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md, required notices, README/install instructions, and applicable third-party content notices. The decision states whether Node is required for the first release. The decision explicitly keeps npm publication and public SDK packaging out of scope.
close_reason: Initial GitHub Release artifact = per-platform self-contained archive bundling a pinned Node 24 runtime (no user-installed Node required), the ABI-matched better-sqlite3 prebuild, built cli+core dist, bundled SRD 5.1 data, and LICENSE/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md/NOTICE + README. Targets: darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64 (WSL), linux-arm64, win32-x64. One-line installer (curl|sh / irm|iex) downloads+unpacks+links a launcher to the bundled Node, mirroring the dolt-provision pattern and staying consistent with ADR 0008. Node is bundled, not user-required. Dolt stays lazy/self-provisioned (off per-turn path). Out of scope: npm publish (private guards stay), public @eshyra/core SDK packaging, and single-file SEA/Bun executable (deferred). Full design recorded on the bead. Unblocks eshyra-0p8u and eshyra-4kdt.
